Watched The Awful Truth. RomCom has a pretty pre-code feel despite technically not violating the Hayes Code. Cary Grant is fantastic, and Dunne feels like a Hepburn clone in parts, but probably they’re all just in the same soup. Lots of small moments that show why they’re both stars.

I had a fun time animating a Grave Lily decaying for a Dot-Man power-up! Not the most complex art or animation, but it is a nice little touch for the game feel.

Watched The Amazing Adventure. Cary Grant was fantastic despite being in a fairly predictable plot. Sadly the cut that survived the war was about 20 minutes shorter than the original and it showed in parts. Fun as a time capsule of the Great Depression!

Figuring out the best way to have Dot-Man be able to clear collapsed rubble with his “Tunnel Boring” upgrade was a fun challenge. Finding ways to have it happen smoothly and leave the right amount of rubble behind was fun!
